title: Multimatch: one request matching several application segments

prose.text: Multimatch changes whether a destination can match more than one application segment.

prose.label: Default and switch.
prose.text: The definition, the exact-match default and the wildcard catching undefined ports are in [[zpa.policy.multimatch:multimatch-definition]], [[zpa.policy.multimatch:exact-match-default]] and [[zpa.policy.multimatch:multimatch-catches-undefined-ports]]. The request field values are in [[zpa.policy.multimatch:match-style-values]], and [[zpa.policy.multimatch:match-style-domain-constraint]].

prose.label: Which segments match.
prose.text: Matches run from most specific to least and stop at the first segment without Multimatch: [[zpa.policy.multimatch:match-order]]. {{gap:multimatch-chain-example}}

prose.label: Policy across the matches.
prose.text: Rules of every matched segment are searched: [[zpa.policy.multimatch:rules-of-all-matched-segments]]. The block-rule example is open [[zpa.policy.multimatch:block-rule-with-multimatch]]. Rule evaluation order itself is in [[zpa.policy.evaluation-order]].

prose.label: Without Multimatch.
prose.text: Exact match, carve-outs and port misses are in [[zpa.app-segments.matching]].

checks.do: Whether every segment that covers the domain has the same matchStyle, since a mix is a conflict the update rejects.
Where the chain of segments for the requested host stops, at the first segment that does not support Multimatch.
Which rules in the access policy cover each matched segment, since the policy search runs across all of them in rule order.

config-conflict.statement: When Multimatch is enabled or disabled on a segment, Private Access checks every other segment with overlapping domains, and a domain found in segments with different Multimatch settings is a conflict that stops the segment from being updated.

quotes: Private Access checks all other application segments that contains any overlapping domains to determine whether the change is allowed.
If a domain is found in multiple application segments with different Multimatch settings, there is a conflict and the application segment cannot be updated.

multimatch-chain-example.title: Which application segments a server1.db.hr.company.com request matches under Multimatch (documented example)
multimatch-chain-example.blocks: the example of which Multimatch-enabled segments match a nested-wildcard request and which do not
multimatch-chain-example.detail: Unverified legacy statement: "In the documented example, a request for `server1.db.hr.company.com` matches `*.db.hr.company.com` and `*.hr.company.com`, which have Multimatch enabled, and does not match `*.ui.hr.company.com` or `*.company.com`, which have it disabled."
